spec_match.rationale: Models the performance contract that motivates the depth modifiers — early-Z kept vs disabled vs regained — across the three shader forms, with honest labelling that this is arithmetic about invocations, not a GPU measurement.

interactive.rationale: Pixels/depth-complexity/shader-cost sliders and a sorted checkbox re-run the model live; verified the unsorted case at 8x complexity produced distinct kept/disabled/regained rows and updated narration.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises the invocation arithmetic with and without the modifier, which the model, bars and table deliver.

edge_cases.rationale: The unsorted-geometry case — where early-Z is worth little regardless — is a first-class state with its own explanation, and out-of-range slider input clamps sanely.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite covers the compile contracts the model assumes; on this GPU-less build it ran 3 pass / 4 fail consistent with no adapter.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): exercised the depth-complexity slider and the sorted toggle — rows moved from 1.00M/1.00M/1.00M at 1x to 4.00M/8.00M/4.00M unsorted at 8x with the correct 'sorting is what makes the modifier worth it' narration; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs overdraw/sorted/saved per render.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, bars carry text labels, captioned table, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Sliders and checkbox are labelled with live value spans, the bar lanes carry text invocation counts, detail is aria-live.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360x740 DPR3 the document scrollWidth is 508px: the side-by-side slider grid, the note, the bars and the results table all clip at the right edge (mobile screenshot read).

openQuestions.title: Fix the 508px-wide layout at a 360px viewport
openQuestions.detail: The controls grid keeps two slider columns side by side at 360px (min-width on the range inputs plus the auto-fit minmax not collapsing), pushing the page to 508px and clipping the second slider, the note, the bar lanes and the invocations table. Let the controls stack to one column below ~420px, drop the range min-width, and add overflow-wrap to the table; re-verify with deno task responsive-check.

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/webgpu-wgsl-fragment-depth/early-z/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). The model is sound and fully interactive — verified the arithmetic responds correctly to depth complexity and the front-to-back toggle, including the unsorted case where the page honestly says the modifier buys little — and it never pretends to be a GPU measurement. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact. The one real defect is responsive: 508px scrollWidth at 360px with clipped controls and table, the worst mobile overflow in this milestone's review, failing mobile parity until the controls stack.
